chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Barqi, raising it from Zayd al-Shahham, Abu Usamah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I was circumambulating with Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him). Whenever he reached the Stone, he wiped it with his hand and kissed it; and whenever he reached the Yamani Corner, he embraced it. I said, 'May I be your ransom, you wipe the Stone with your hand and embrace the Yamani Corner?' He said, 'Rasool Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: I do not come to the Yamani Corner except that I find Jibraeel (peace be upon him) having preceded me to it, embracing it.'

key_terms.يَلْتَزِمُهُ: He embraces it (referring to the ritual embrace of the corner)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of embracing the Yamani Corner during Tawaf according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* establishes the Sunnah of the Prophet and Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in Tawaf, emphasizing the tactile reverence for the Black Stone and the Yamani Corner. It provides a profound theological link to the celestial realm by noting that Archangel Jibraeel preceded the Prophet in embracing the Yamani Corner, thereby validating these physical acts as imitations of divine worship. This narration underscores the Shia emphasis on following the Prophet's specific ritual details as transmitted through the Imams.
